chapter.verse: Tua bang ahihleh Jew mite in bang hamphatna nei uh ahi hiam? Vun-atna ii manneihna bang ahi hiam?
A namkimin tampi om hi. Khatna ah, Pasian' genkhiat thute Jew mite' kiangah ki-ap hi.
Tua ahihleh kimkhat in a up loh manin amaute' uplohna in Pasian' cihtakna maimangsak ahi hiam?

Hi peuhmah lo hi. Mi khempeuh zuauphuak ahi phial zongin Pasian ahihleh a nuai-a kigelh bangin a thumaan hita hen: “Na thugenna tawh diksakna na ngah ding a, thu hong kikhen ciangin thu na zo ding hi.”

Thukhat ah, eite' siattatna hangin Pasian' dikna thu hong kilang ahihleh bang i gen nawn ding hiam? Ei' tungah hehna hong tunsak pen Pasian a diktat loh man ahi hiam? (Mihing zia bangin hong pau pak ka hi hi).
Hi peuhmah lo hi. Tua bang hileh Pasian in leitung bangci thukhen theih ding ahi hiam?
Ahih hangin kei' zuautheihna tungtawnin Pasian' thuman thutak in Pasian' minpha khangsak ahihleh bang hangin kei mawhnei khat bangin thu hong kikhen lai ahi hiam?
Thuhoih a pian nadingin thusia bawl lehang hilo hiam?—hih bangin gen ci-in mi kimkhat in ko hong daisak uh hi. Tua mite gawtna a tuahtaak ahi hi.
Tua ahihleh bang hiding hiam? Ko Jew mite hamphazaw ka hi uh hiam? Hi peuhmah lo hi. A hang pen Jew leh Greek a vekpi-un mawhna nuai-ah om ci-in i ngawh khinzo hi.
Hih bangin zong kigelh hi: “A dik kuamah om lo, khat zong om lo hi;
thu a theitel kuamah om lo, Pasian a zongkhia kuamah om lo hi.
A vekpi-un lampial khin uh a, a kisia hita uh hi; migitna tawh gamta kuamah om lo, khat nangawn zong om lo hi.”
“A gawl uh hankhuk kihongsa bang hi a, a leii uh tawh mi khem uh hi.” “A muk sung uhah gulgu om hi.”
“A kam uh haamsiatna leh ngongpauna tawh kidim hi.”
“Sisan kisuah nadingin a khete uh zuan-gang a,
a zawite uhah kisiatna leh lunggimna omin
amaute in nopna lemna lampi thei nailo uh hi.”
“Amau' muhna ah Pasian kihtakna thu om lo hi.”
Tu-in thukhun in a gen khatpeuh, thukhun nuai-a omte' kianga kigen ahihlam i thei hi. Tua pen kam khempeuh kibingsakin leitung bup in a sepna bang tek Pasian' mai-ah mawhpuak a neih nading uh ahi hi.
A hang pen thukhun hangin mawhna thu a cingin a kithei ahih manin thukhun zuihna tawh Pasian' mai-ah diksakna a ngah mihing' ta kuamah om lo ding hi.
Ahih hangin Thukhun Laibu leh Kamsang Laibu in teci a pan uh Pasian' dikna thu pen tu-in thukhun kul lo-in hong kilangkhia khinzo hi.
Tua pen khentuamna om lo, a umte khempeuh' ading Jesu Khris ii ciamkipna tungtawna kingah Pasian' dikna ahi hi.
A hang pen mi khempeuh mawh khinzo uh a, Pasian' minpha tawh kituak zolo uh hi.
Himah taleh amaute in Pasian' hehpihna tawh Khris Jesu' sunga om tatkhiatna thu tungtawnin diksakna thupha, a khawnkhongin ngah uh hi.

Tua Jesu pen a sisan hangin upna tawh a kingah mawhphelna thu ahi dingin Pasian in hong laakkhiat hi. Hih pen Pasian in ama' dikna thu hong lahna ahi hi. A hang pen amah in a beisa huna mawhnate lungduaitak koihkhong phot hi.
Amah a diktat ahih nadingin leh Jesu' ciamkipna hangin diksakna a piapa ahih nadingin Pasian in tu hun lianin ama' dikna thu hong lak ahi hi.
Tua ahihleh kisialh nading koi ah om ahi hiam? Kihemkhia khinta hi. Bang thukhun tawh hiam? Sepna thukhun tawh hiam? Hilo hi, upna thukhun tawh ahi hi.
Tua hi a, thukhun zuihna hang hilo, upna hangin diksakna kingah ci-in i ciamteh hi.
Hilo ahihleh, Pasian pen Jew mite' Pasian bek ahi hiam? Gentile mite' Pasian zong hilo ahi hiam? Hi hi, Gentile mite' Pasian zong ahi hi.
Pasian khat bek om hi—vun-at mite a upna uh tawh ahi zongin, vun-atloh mite a upna uh tungtawnin ahi zongin, diksakna a pia ding pen amah ahi hi.
Tua ahihleh hih upna hangin thukhun suphiat ding i hi hiam? Hilo kisa-in thukhun a lenkip i hizaw hi.
